description:
Free open-source YouTube downloader GUI based on yt-dlp for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Download videos, Shorts, 4K, 1080p60, HDR, and subtitles with no ads, tracking, cookies, or login. Supports 9 languages.

Arroxy is a free, open-source desktop app for downloading YouTube videos and Shorts in up to 4K, 1080p60, HDR, and audio-only formats with no ads, tracking, or login required.
Install
Windows Setup Windows Portable
macOS Apple Silicon macOS Intel
Linux AppImage Linux Flatpak Linux tar.gz
SHA256
A small release that makes sure every install hears about new versions.
Fixes
- Every install now hears about new releases. The Linux tar.gz install never checked for updates before; it now shows the update banner and sends you to the new release on GitHub. The AppImage keeps Install & Restart.
- Arroxy no longer starts a second update check while an update is still downloading.
What's Changed
- feat: per-package heartbeat channels, no dev heartbeats, update notice for every install by @antonio-orionus in #313
Full Changelog: v0.6.1...v0.6.2
